content.title: Get an auto insurance quote
content.description: A customer obtains an auto insurance quote by entering one primary driver's age and driving experience plus one vehicle's make, model, year, value, and registration number, selecting exactly one coverage tier and any allowed add-ons, and reviewing a calculated premium with a breakdown before payment; the guided flow is completed in order but lets the customer go back and change earlier inputs, recalculates the premium when inputs change, and enforces quote eligibility and validation rules including required fields, registration-format checks, Zero Depreciation only with Comprehensive, Comprehensive only when vehicle value is greater than $0, discount limits, and the final premium floor.
content.summary: Enter driver and vehicle details to receive a priced quote.
content.value: Gives the customer a transparent, accurate price so they can decide whether to buy online.
criteria: Quote input fields include driver age, driving experience, vehicle make, vehicle model, vehicle year, vehicle value, and registration number.
This version supports one vehicle and one primary driver only.
The customer chooses exactly one coverage tier: Third-Party or Comprehensive.
Optional add-ons are Roadside Assistance ($40) and Zero Depreciation ($75), with Zero Depreciation available for Comprehensive only.
Base premium is $500 for Third-Party and $800 for Comprehensive.
If driver age is under 25, a 20% surcharge is added after add-ons and before other discounts.
If driving experience is 5 or more years, a 10% discount is applied.
Total discount on any premium is capped at 20%.
The final premium floor after discounts is $300.
Zero Depreciation cannot be selected or applied with Third-Party cover.
Comprehensive requires vehicle value greater than $0; missing or zero value blocks selection and prompts for a valid value.
Registration number is required, must be 4 to 10 alphanumeric characters, and empty or invalid values block progress past Step 1 with a clear error.
Any required field left empty blocks progress with a field-level error.
Going back to a previous step to change inputs recalculates the premium.
